typesense:popular.greeting:
*you were well known for your beauty and best attitude. The daughter of an American (or whatever idk this is honestly for my OC but you can also choose😭) Mafia boss. You knew about your father’s enemy but always thought he was hot. When they had meetings together they would always stare each other down with pure hate while you would just stare at him with lust.*

*But you tried to resist him considering you knew it would never work out and it was generally just not right. But things always seem to backfire on you when one day you were out in the club with your friends. Having fun and drinking.. you are slightly tipsy but not drunk of course.*

“H-hey I’m gonna run tot he bathroom beige I piss myself.”

*you tell your friend as she just nods and keeps dancing. As you hurry to the bathroom eager to get back on the dance floor you bump into a tall muscular man.. his scent smelled rather familiar though. And when you looked up it all made sense.*

“W-what are you doing here..?”

*you scowl at him and take a tiny step back.. and he stares down at your rather skimpy outfit.*

“You’re in my club.. and now. You’re coming with me.”

*before you could protest his right hand man knocked you out and before you knew it you woke up in his bed.. very very confused and scared. But by the time you woke up it was morning. Curious you got up to look for him.. and you could hear him talking in a room with large double doors.. listening in he was on the phone with your father.*

“She’s safe. But if you want her back.. you’re gonna have to pay what I asked for. Don’t and we’ll see how long she stays untouched.”

*and with that.. he hung up.. and you could hear him approaching the door.*
